findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_listing_guidelines, check_build, submit_game, get_review, update_game · Private data: check_build, create_studio, publish_game, submit_game, update_game, submit_settlement · Public sink: check_build, publish_game, submit_game, add_pact, respond_to_claim, submit_settlement, browse_games · Destructive: check_build, get_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_listing_guidelines, check_build, submit_game, get_review, update_game · Private data: check_build, create_studio, publish_game, submit_game, update_game, submit_settlement · Public sink: check_build, publish_game, submit_game, add_pact, respond_to_claim, submit_settlement, browse_games · Destructive: check_build, get_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
